subsets.name: Auto Base
subsets.note: On-chrome autograph across all eight subsets, on Rainbow foil board. Every card is numbered 1 of 1. Color Parallels: Red, Navy, Blue, Green, Purple, Gold, Orange, Gray, Lime, Pink, Rainbow, Tie Dye 1, Tie Dye 2, Tie Dye 3, Tie Dye 4.

subsets.name: Auto Base Vinyl
subsets.note: On-vinyl autograph across all eight subsets, on Rainbow foil board. Every card is numbered 1 of 1. Color Parallels: Red, Navy, Blue, Green, Purple, Gold, Orange, Gray, Lime, Pink, Rainbow, Tie Dye 1, Tie Dye 2, Tie Dye 3, Tie Dye 4.

subsets.name: Auto Base True Color Match
subsets.note: True Color Match autograph across all eight subsets, on Rainbow foil board. All cards are True 1 of 1s (CMWC prefix).

subsets.name: Auto Base True Color Match Vinyl
subsets.note: True Color Match autograph on vinyl across all eight subsets, on Rainbow foil board. All cards are True 1 of 1s (CMWC prefix).

subsets.name: Base Non-Auto
subsets.note: Unsigned on-chrome parallels across all eight subsets. Ten foil boards — Mirror, Mojo, Stealth, Island, Sparkles, Raywave, Shimmer, Mini Boxes, Laterum and Laser — each offered in up to ~13 color parallels (Orange, Purple, Green, Red, Blue, Lime, Navy, Pink, Gray, Gold plus Rainbow / Tie Dye 1-4 on the top boards). Print runs form a per-subset x per-color matrix and vary by board (highest runs on Mirror at roughly /25, tightening down the ladder to as low as /4); exact per-color runs are on the production master and are not collapsed to a single figure here.

subsets.name: Base Non-Auto Vinyl
subsets.note: Unsigned on-vinyl parallels across all eight subsets. Nine foil boards — Rainbow, Mosaic, CrossHatch, Ripple, Donut Circles, Lava, Pulsar, Kaleidoscope and CrystalHolo — each offered in up to ~13 color parallels. Print runs form a per-subset x per-color matrix and vary by board (roughly /15 down to /2); exact per-color runs are on the production master and are not collapsed to a single figure here.
